subject.title: Plugin UI: add scoped action bridge for sandboxed tabs

question: Should OpenClaw publish `sessionActions`, `allowChatNavigation`, and `contextTokens` as a stable Plugin SDK/Gateway contract for sandboxed external tabs, or should this capability remain out of core until a narrower owner-approved design exists?
rationale: This is a new compatibility-sensitive extension seam spanning plugin registration, Gateway protocol, web UI, native protocol models, and security boundaries; mechanical review cannot choose its permanent public API shape.

options.title: Approve a narrow stable bridge
options.body: Keep the descriptor-scoped action and navigation capabilities, but derive authoritative context metadata at the Gateway boundary and document compatibility guarantees.

options.title: Defer the public contract
options.body: Pause this PR and first define a narrower owner-approved plugin capability API before exposing it through Gateway and native clients.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrow stable bridge
recommendation.body: Keep the descriptor-scoped action and navigation capabilities, but derive authoritative context metadata at the Gateway boundary and document compatibility guarantees.

likelyOwner.reason: This PR extends the merged external plugin-tab authentication and sandbox boundary introduced by that work.
